# Youssef Manssouri

> Business Analytics & AI Student at EMAA Business School · Digital Product Builder

Youssef Manssouri is a full-stack digital product builder and business analytics student based in Agadir, Morocco. He engineers web applications, SaaS tools, e-commerce storefronts, and KPI dashboards using Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, and Tailwind CSS.

## Core Technologies & Capabilities

- **Frontend & Full-Stack**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5.7, Tailwind CSS, Server Actions, Zod validation
- **Backend & Database**: PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM (relational schemas, RBAC authorization), Node.js, Python, Django
- **Analytics & Visualization**: Recharts telemetry, Business KPI modeling, financial cash-flow tracking, Google Gemini AI integration

## Major Projects & Case Studies

- [BusinessOS](https://www.youssefmanssouri.site/projects/businessos): Flagship business operations platform unifying 7 core modules (CRM deal pipeline, itemized invoicing, appointment calendar, employee HR directory with RBAC, cash flow ledger, Kanban task workflow, and Recharts financial analytics) with a 15-model Prisma relational schema.
  - Live Application: https://business-os-manssouri.vercel.app
  - Source Code: https://github.com/youssefmanssouri/business-os
- [Lumière Parfums](https://www.youssefmanssouri.site/projects/lumiere-parfums): Custom fragrance e-commerce experience designed for online scent discovery, multi-attribute accord filtering, editorial scent pyramid breakdowns, persistent cart continuity, and administrative store management.
  - Live Application: https://lumiere-parfums-mu.vercel.app/
  - Source Code: https://github.com/youssefmanssouri/lumiere-parfums
- [Gym CRM](https://www.youssefmanssouri.site/projects/gym-crm): Gym operations platform designed to streamline front-desk check-ins, track membership renewal statuses (Active, Expired, Frozen), organize group class schedules, and monitor recurring facility revenue.
  - Live Application: https://gym-crm-gules.vercel.app
  - Source Code: https://github.com/youssefmanssouri/gym-crm
